body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> Earthquake displayed its small subwoofers ‘MiniMe’ during CES 2008, which is designed for home theater, music or gaming applications. The MiniMe subwoofers are available in 8-, 10- and 12-inch sizes and range from 320 to 600 watts.
